text: # Activating an eSIM on a Compatible Device **Document ID:** MAN_ESIM_001 **Category:** C05 — SIM Card Services **Department:** Customer Care **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-05-16 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base --- ## Feature Overview # Activating an eSIM on a Compatible Device **Document ID:** MAN_ESIM_001 **Category:** C05 — SIM Card Services **Last Updated:** 2026-07-22 **Version:** 1.0 --- ## Requirements An eSIM-compatible, network-unlocked device and an active NovaTel connection eligible for eSIM conversion. ## Steps 1. Request eSIM conversion via SIM Services > eSIM in the app. 2. Scan the QR code emailed/displayed upon approval using Settings > Add Cellular Plan. 3. Wait for activation confirmation (typically within 10 minutes). ## Notes The physical SIM is deactivated automatically once the eSIM profile is confirmed active. ## Prerequisites - A supported device/app version. - An active NovaTel connection registered to your account. ## Step-by-Step Instructions 1. Open the relevant section in the app or device settings. 2. Follow the on-screen prompts to complete setup or configuration. 3. Confirm the feature is active by checking the relevant status indicator. ## Common Errors | Error | Likely Cause | Fix | |---|---|---| | Feature not appearing | App/device not updated | Update to the latest supported version | | Setup fails to complete | Network connectivity issue during setup | Retry on stable Wi-Fi/data | ## Troubleshooting If the above does not resolve the issue, restart the device/app and retry; if it persists, contact support with the exact error shown. ##
title: Activating an eSIM on a Compatible Device
